record.name: Xero Accounting for business
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
With Xero Accounting, keep track of cash flow, view income, manage expenses, and create invoices - or ask JAX, your AI finance partner, right from your phone. The Xero Accounting app is a business tracking app, ideal for small business owners, managers and landlords. The app acts as a companion to your Xero account, helping you stay productive and keep an eye on your business’ financial health, when and where it suits you. Managing your business finances, invoices, cash flow, income and expenses, has never been so easy.

~

Features:

MANAGE INVOICING ON THE GO
• Raise & send quotes for faster client approval & get started on the job sooner
• Reduce the time it takes to get paid by raising & sending invoices from your device as soon as the job is completed
• Send invoices directly to clients via email, text message or other apps
• Easily keep track of unpaid invoices, to see who owes you what - and even track the status of an invoice, seeing if it has been viewed by clients
• For US users, automatically calculate sales tax on invoices for any state or jurisdiction

MANAGE SPEND
• Record spend as soon as it happens to reduce office admin & time spent looking for lost receipts

MANAGE CUSTOMER & SUPPLIER INFORMATION
• Have vital contact information in the palm of your hand so you can do business from wherever you are
• Get a view of how much is owed and quickly add notes so you can build better business relationships

RECONCILE FROM ANYWHERE
• Good bookkeeping habits have been made easy - Smart matches, rules & suggestions makes reconciling your business transactions easy, from anywhere with a few simple clicks
• Filter bank statement lines to optimize your unique workflow, leading to faster reconciliation
• New sort & search tools to make it easier to view business transactions & streamline the reconciliation process

ACCEPT CONTACTLESS PAYMENTS RIGHT ON YOUR iPhone
(currently only available in the US, Australia, the UK, New Zealand & Canada)
• Accept in-person, contactless payments right on your iPhone, so you can reach new customers & take payments on the go
• Accept contactless payments from physical debit/credit cards, Apple Pay & other digital wallets. So there’s no need for additional hardware such as card readers or terminals
• Privacy & security of iPhone built in. Apple doesn’t store card numbers or PIN information on your iPhone or Apple servers, so merchants & customers can rest assured that their data stays theirs
• Tap to Pay on in the Xero Accounting App is free to set up, with no ongoing or monthly subscription fees. Stripe transactions fees still apply
• Save time, improve cash flow & focus on growing your business

KEEP TRACK OF CASH FLOW
• View summaries of outstanding bills & invoices to see what’s owed
• Quickly & easily create bills by capturing photos or selecting files from your mobile device, with our new automatic bill uploader with AI

AI-POWERED FINANCE PARTNER
Get instant answers on your financial performance — revenue and profit trends, or your current cash position.
Create, edit, approve and send a quote or invoice, and get answers to invoice-related questions.
Snap a photo or upload a document to get instant, secure answers and summaries.
Ask JAX how to use a Xero feature, and get answers based on Xero Central's help content.

~

XERO ACCOUNTING APP IS POWERED BY XERO
To contact support, visit us at https://central.xero.com/, raise a ticket, book a call & someone will reach out to you
Got product & feature ideas for the Xero Accounting App? Visit https://productideas.xero.com/

You're in good hands with Xero. We're rated GREAT on Trustpilot (4/5) with 11K+ customer reviews (as of July 2026)

Downloading & accessing the Xero Accounting mobile app is subject to the acceptance of Apple's Standard EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
More terms apply if you use Xero's services, see https://www.xero.com/legal/terms/

ProMuse: AI Skills & Certificate Program
Build practical AI skills through structured learning and showcase your progress with certificates you can proudly share. ProMuse is designed to help learners develop real-world AI abilities through guided lessons, hands-on practice, and clear learning paths from beginner to advanced use cases.
Instead of jumping between scattered tips and disconnected tutorials, ProMuse offers a more organized way to learn. Each program is designed to help you understand AI tools, apply them in real scenarios, and make steady, measurable progress over time.

What makes ProMuse different
Structured learning paths
Follow step-by-step programs that guide you through AI concepts, tools, and workflows in a clear and logical order.
Practical AI application
Learn how to use AI in everyday work across writing, research, communication, productivity, and content creation.
Certificate-based learning
Complete eligible programs and earn certificates that reflect your learning progress and course completion.
Practice-focused lessons
Apply what you learn through exercises and scenarios inspired by real tasks, not just passive reading.
Progress tracking across devices
Track completed lessons, milestones, and certificates in one place, with progress available across your devices.

Who ProMuse is for
	•	Professionals looking to strengthen their digital and AI skills
	•	Founders and business operators exploring AI for productivity and growth
	•	Career changers preparing for more tech-driven roles
	•	Learners who prefer structured education over random content

Why certificates matter
In a fast-changing work environment, visible proof of learning can be valuable. ProMuse certificates are designed to recognize course completion and continued progress as you build practical AI skills.

Subscription Information
ProMuse offers auto-renewable subscriptions that may provide access to lessons, learning programs, and certificate-related features.
	•	Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
	•	Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
	•	You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Email us at team@promuse.ai

Privacy Policy: https://promuse.ai/settings/privacy-policy

Create an ecommerce store that's built to sell, no coding required.

Sell wherever your customers shop: online, in person, in AI chats, on social, and across marketplaces.

- Reach shoppers where they already shop: AI chats, Shop, social, and marketplaces

- Create marketing campaigns, promotions, and discounts

- Get instant notifications when new orders arrive
- Manage customer profiles and segments, and message customers directly

- Scan barcodes and adjust inventory on the go
